events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) adjusts his path and slips the contact with Podziemski (GSW), who attempts to draw the offensive foul.
Butler III (GSW) legally contests Irving's (DAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Marshall (DAL) and Butler III (GSW) grab each others' arms briefly, but both players are able to move freely.
Edwards (DAL) cleanly blocks the shot attempt by Butler III (GSW) and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Butler III (GSW) lowers his arm following the shot attempt and the contact with Marshall's (DAL) head/face is marginal.
Marshall (DAL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Moody's (GSW) driving shot attempt.
Green (GSW) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Edwards' (DAL) layup attempt.
Curry (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Marshall's (DAL) possession. The ensuing contact by Green (GSW) as the ball is already coming loose is incidental.
Marshall (DAL) initiates illegal body contact with Curry (GSW) that affects his SQBR.

Replay review of the foul called on Butler III (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Irving (DAL) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Butler III's path and absorbs the contact initiated by Butler III.
Butler III (GSW) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to cause Irving (DAL) to lose control.
Podziemski (GSW) commits a take foul on Christie (DAL).
Marshall (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect the pass away from Butler III (GSW).
